text: SEO Audit Services: Find What’s Limiting Your Rankings Updated on: 5th Nov 2026 Updated by: Ciaran Connolly Table of Contents Most underperforming websites do not have a single cause. They have several, stacked on top of each other. SEO audit services identify the specific technical, content, and authority issues holding a site back, then rank them by impact, so you know what to fix first. ProfileTree provides SEO audit services across Northern Ireland, Ireland, and the UK, working from Google Search Console and Google Analytics access through to a full technical crawl of the site. The aim is not a long list of problems. It is a prioritised action plan your developers can use straight away, alongside strategic recommendations tied to business outcomes such as leads and enquiries, not just rankings on a screen. If you are weighing up an automated tool export against a properly scoped, expert-led audit, the difference shows up fastest in the recommendations themselves. A crawler flags broken links and missing meta tags. An experienced auditor tells you which three fixes will move the needle this quarter, and which can genuinely wait. Every underperforming site has a reason for its poor visibility: a technical barrier stopping Google from crawling it properly, content that does not match what searchers want, or competitors doing SEO better. Good SEO audit services turn that vague sense that “something’s wrong” into a concrete, evidenced list of what to fix and why, whether you’re searching for SEO audit Belfast specifically or comparing professional SEO audit services further afield. What Is an SEO Audit? SEO audit services provide a structured review of every factor affecting a website’s search performance, covering technical health, on-page content, and external authority signals. Rather than guessing at what is wrong, you get a documented, prioritised view of what is actually happening on your site. Professional SEO audit services also draw on Google Analytics; our Google Analytics audit services element specifically looks at behaviour flow and conversion paths, not just Search Console rankings data. Think of it as a diagnostic process. A website symptom, say, poor rankings for a target keyword, gets traced back through the audit to a specific cause: thin content, weak internal linking, or a slow-loading template. The treatment plan that follows addresses the cause directly, rather than applying generic fixes and hoping something sticks. A thorough audit typically surfaces six kinds of findings: technical barriers such as crawl errors or slow page speed; content gaps where pages are thin or missing outright; authority weaknesses in the backlink profile; competitive shortfalls where rivals simply do specific things better; quick wins that need minutes rather than months; and strategic priorities that shape the next two or three quarters of work. Separating these matters matters because a business with limited time needs to know which category to tackle first. Audit vs Ongoing SEO Support An audit and ongoing SEO work serve different purposes, and confusing the two leads to unrealistic expectations either way. SEO Audit Ongoing SEO Point-in-time analysis Continuous optimisation Identifies issues Implements fixes Provides the plan Carries out the plan Typically, a one-off engagement Usually, a monthly retainer Audits often come first, providing the blueprint that ongoing work then implements. Our search engine optimisation team frequently picks up straight after SEO auditing services conclude, working through the priority list phase by phase rather than trying to fix everything in the first week. Why Businesses Need SEO Audit Services Several situations tend to trigger the need for proper SEO audit services rather than a quick health check. Diagnosing Ranking Problems Rankings have dropped, or never materialised in the first place, and you know something is wrong without knowing exactly what. Systematic analysis replaces guesswork with specific, evidence-based causes, so you are fixing the actual problem rather than the most visible symptom. This matters especially where a site has had several small changes made by different people over time; SEO auditing services trace the current state back to its actual causes rather than assuming the most recent change is to blame. Before a Redesign, Migration, or New Launch Redesigns and migrations put existing rankings at risk if SEO isn’t considered from the outset. An audit documents current assets, rankings, backlinks, and content worth preserving, before development starts, and flags redirect and content risks before they cause lasting damage. New sites benefit from the same discipline in reverse: establishing proper technical foundations before bad habits become entrenched in the site’s structure. Businesses migrating domains between the UK and Ireland face an additional layer here, since hreflang and CC-TLD handling (.co.uk versus .ie) rarely gets the attention it needs. We work from a dedicated website migration checklist for exactly this scenario, covering redirect mapping, canonical handling, and which content genuinely needs a separate Irish version rather than a swapped currency symbol. Any website migration checklist worth using also cross-references Google Analytics goals and conversion tracking, so nothing gets lost when the domain changes. Competitive Gaps and Periodic Health Checks Sometimes the honest answer to “why do competitors rank better?” only emerges once you compare both sites across the same set of technical, content, and authority factors side by side. A competitive audit isolates exactly where the gap sits, rather than leaving you to guess between content, links, or technical performance. Regular health checks catch smaller issues before they compound into larger ranking problems, and give you an objective baseline before engaging or evaluating any SEO agency, including us. Businesses often come to this stage after several years of ad hoc changes, where nobody has looked at the site as a whole for some time. It’s often the point where a business decides to buy SEO audit services for the first time, having previously relied on ad hoc content seo audit services carried out internally. Our Four-Pillar SEO Audit Framework Every ProfileTree audit works through four connected pillars. Each one feeds into the priority matrix that follows, so nothing gets flagged in isolation from the rest of the site. Technical Foundations and Core Web Vitals We start with crawlability: robots.txt configuration, XML sitemap accuracy, crawl errors, and whether JavaScript rendering blocks content from Google entirely. Indexation gets checked next, including canonical tags, noindex directives, and duplicate or thin content sitting in the index unnecessarily. Performance sits alongside this. Core Web Vitals (loading, interactivity, and visual stability) are measured across mobile and desktop, since Google’s own systems treat page experience as part of overall ranking evaluation, even where it is not the single deciding factor. Where hosting is the bottleneck, this is usually where our website hosting and management team gets involved directly, since a fast front end still depends on a properly configured server behind it. This is also where Google Analytics audit services cross-check crawl data against real user behaviour, and where a website migration checklist gets referenced if the site has changed domains or CMS recently. On-Page and Content Gap Analysis Title tags, meta descriptions, and heading structure get reviewed page by page for uniqueness and keyword placement, not just presence. Content gets a full inventory: word count, search intent alignment, and where keyword cannibalisation is quietly splitting authority across two competing pages instead of one. This is also where we map genuine content gaps against what is already ranking, then flag where fresh content marketing work would close the distance fastest. A content seo audit services engagement on its own, without the technical layer behind it, only ever tells half the story, since even excellent content struggles to rank on a site with crawl or indexation problems underneath it. Backlink and Authority Health Referring domains, link quality, and anchor text distribution are assessed against natural patterns rather than obviously manipulated ones. We also look for toxic links worth disavowing and, just as importantly, the specific link gaps where competitors have earned coverage you haven’t. Local authority signals get checked separately: Google Business Profile completeness, citation consistency, and review volume and response rate, since these carry real weight for any business relying on local search, including seo audit Belfast searches from businesses based here in Northern Ireland specifically. Authority findings here often feed straight back into content seo audit services recommendations, since thin backlink profiles and thin content tend to sit on the same pages. UK and Ireland Market Alignment Most audit tools and agency reports are built around US search behaviour by default, which misses several things that matter for UK and Ireland-based businesses specifically. VAT display requirements on ecommerce pages, UK-specific regulatory content, and genuinely local search behaviour all affect how a site should be structured, not just what it says on the page. Cross-border businesses trading between Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland face a further layer: correct hreflang implementation and a clear decision on .co.uk versus .ie domain strategy, both of which get missed constantly by generic, US-centric audit templates that were never built with this market in mind. Types of SEO Audit We Offer Not every business needs the same scope from SEO audit services, and matching the audit type to the actual problem saves time and budget on both sides, whether you’re specifically searching for SEO audit Belfast or a broader UK-wide engagement. Full SEO Audit A complete analysis across all four pillars, typically taking two to four weeks, depending on site size. This is the right starting point before a major SEO investment, a significant redesign, or an annual strategic review, since it establishes a full baseline rather than a partial one. Most businesses that buy SEO audit services for the first time start here, since it gives the broadest possible view before committing to professional SEO audit services on an ongoing basis. Technical SEO Audit A focused review of technical factors only is usually completed within one to two weeks. Development teams often request this specifically after a migration, or when troubleshooting a sudden performance issue, since it isolates technical causes without the wider content and authority review. These narrower SEO auditing services are usually run straight from a website migration checklist when the trigger is a recent domain or platform change. Content Audit An inventory and quality assessment of every page on the site, mapped against search intent and current rankings. This suits businesses planning a content strategy refresh, consolidating overlapping pages, or preparing an editorial calendar for the year ahead, and typically takes one to three weeks, depending on how many pages need reviewing. These content seo audit services sit alongside our broader SEO auditing services rather than replacing the technical review entirely. Quick SEO Health Check A high-level overview of the major issues only, delivered within three to five business days, with a light-touch look at Google Analytics audit services alongside the core technical checks. This works well as an initial assessment where the budget is tight, or where you simply need a sense-check before committing to a larger engagement. The Implementation Gap: Making Sure Recommendations Get Fixed Most SEO audit services fail at the same point: the handover. A lengthy document full of findings lands on a developer’s desk with no clear priority order, and six months later, nothing has changed because nobody knew where to start. The Priority Matrix: Effort Versus Commercial Impact We plot every recommendation against two axes: effort required and commercial impact. A broken redirect chain on a checkout page might take twenty minutes to fix and directly affect revenue; that is a quick win, actioned first. A full information architecture rebuild might take months and matter enormously, but it gets scheduled as a longer-term strategic project rather than competing for the same week’s attention as the quick wins. This matrix turns a report into a plan. Without it, teams work through findings in document order, rarely the order that matters most, and it is a step that SEO auditing services often skip. Developer-Ready Handover Documentation Recommendations get written for the person implementing them, not just the person reading the report. That means specific file paths, exact redirect rules, and clear acceptance criteria that your developers, whether in-house or working on a WordPress, Shopify, or WooCommerce build, can action without a follow-up call to clarify what we actually meant. This is also where a development background pays off. Recommendations written by someone who has implemented similar fixes read differently from those from an SEO checklist, and developers notice one of the clearest markers of professional SEO audit services versus a template report. SEO Audit Services Pricing in the UK Costs vary by scope and site size. Quick health checks, covering the major technical and on-page issues at a high level, typically run from £300 to £600. Full audits for small to medium sites, covering the complete four-pillar framework in detail, range from £800 to £2,000. Large or complex sites needing extensive technical crawling and competitive analysis can run from £2,000 upwards. Broadly, we work across three tiers: a foundational scope suited to most SMEs, a growth scope for e-commerce sites with larger catalogues and more complex tracking, and an enterprise scope for international or multi-site businesses with more stakeholders involved in sign-off. We provide a specific quote once we understand your site, your goals, and your current access to Search Console and Analytics, whether you are asking about SEO audit Belfast pricing specifically or a UK-wide engagement. If you’re comparing quotes before you buy SEO audit services from any provider, ask specifically what’s included in the report and whether developer-ready handover documentation is part of the deliverable, since that’s where a lot of cheaper reports fall short in practice. What You Receive From Our SEO Audit Services Our SEO audit services start with a discovery call covering your goals, known concerns, and access to Search Console, Analytics, and the site backend, where needed. From there, we run a full technical crawl, cross-reference it against your Search Console data, and move into manual review, where a person rather than a tool applies business context to what the crawl has found. Whether you are commissioning content seo audit services, our Google Analytics audit services strand, or a full technical review, the same discovery process applies, and it’s the same process whether you buy SEO audit services as a one-off or reference a website migration checklist because you’re moving platforms. Every audit produces a written report with an executive summary for leadership, detailed findings by category, and screenshot evidence, which helps make an issue concrete rather than abstract. Recommendations get organised by priority rather than left as a flat list: Priority Criteria Example Critical Blocks rankings, quick to fix Noindex tag on a key page, broken redirect High Significant impact, reasonable effort Title tag rewrites, content gaps Medium Meaningful improvement, moderate effort Page speed work, internal linking Lower Incremental gains, ongoing work Schema expansion, content refreshes You also get the supporting data behind the report: crawl exports, keyword research, and competitor comparison spreadsheets, plus a presentation meeting to walk through findings and answer questions directly rather than leaving you to interpret a document alone. This is the same package whether you buy SEO audit services on their own or as part of a wider engagement. Why Choose ProfileTree for SEO Audit Services Genuine technical depth matters here, and it’s what separates our professional SEO audit services from a generic tool export. Our team works from a development background, not just an SEO checklist, which means issues get assessed accurately rather than flagged automatically because a tool raised a warning. That covers WordPress, Shopify, and WooCommerce builds specifically, alongside more complex custom sites. We can also act on what we find. Beyond digital strategy recommendations, our own web development and content marketing teams can implement fixes directly, so an audit doesn’t have to sit on a shelf waiting for an internal resource that never quite materialises. This is also why businesses come back to our SEO auditing services for repeat engagements rather than one-off reports. Understanding the UK and Irish market, including SEO audit Belfast searches from businesses on our doorstep, shapes how we prioritise findings. A recommendation suited to a US ecommerce giant does not always translate to an SME serving Belfast, Dublin, or a regional catchment area, so we adjust accordingly rather than applying a template built elsewhere. More than 500 Google reviews with a 5.0 rating. Communication matters as much as the analysis itself. An audit you can’t understand isn’t much use to a busy business owner, so every report is written in plain language, with clear prioritisation and a presentation session included as standard, rather than a document that simply gets emailed over and left for someone to decode alone. Ciaran Connolly, founder of ProfileTree, puts it plainly: “An audit is only as useful as what happens after you receive it. We built our process around the handover specifically, because that is the point where most SEO recommendations quietly die.” FAQs 1. How much does an SEO audit cost in the UK? ProfileTree’s SEO audits start from £425 plus VAT, and the figure depends on the size and complexity of the site, with a site of more than 300 pages quoted separately. The exact figure depends on site size and scope, whether that’s SEO audit Belfast pricing or a larger UK-wide site, so whether you buy SEO audit services as a one-off or alongside ongoing work, we provide a specific quote once we understand your goals and current setup. 2. What’s the difference between a tool export and a manual SEO audit? An automated tool flags technical issues based on fixed rules, without understanding your business or your market. Manual SEO auditing services add human judgement, prioritisation, and context, including competitor reverse-engineering that no automated report provides on its own. That context is usually what turns a list of issues into a plan you can actually act on, whether the focus is content seo audit services or our Google Analytics audit services strand. 3. Will an SEO audit fix my rankings straight away? An audit identifies issues and provides recommendations; it doesn’t implement fixes on its own, and the same applies to our Google Analytics audit services strand, which flags behaviour issues rather than fixing them directly. Rankings improve once recommendations are actioned, and even then, indexing and ranking changes take time to show through fully. Think of the audit as the diagnosis rather than the treatment itself. 4. Do you just deliver a report, or do you fix the issues too? Both options are available. Some clients implement recommendations internally with our support for clarification; others prefer we implement fixes directly through ongoing SEO services, and a hybrid split, developers handling technical fixes while we handle content and strategy, works well for many businesses too. 5. Is an SEO audit necessary before a website migration? Yes. Migrations commonly cause ranking drops from redirect errors or lost content, and professional SEO audit services run beforehand, checked against our website migration checklist, document what needs to be preserved and flag risks before they become expensive to reverse. This applies equally to full replatforms and smaller domain or CMS changes. The off-page factors affecting your SEO The off-page factors affecting your SEO Other factors affecting your organic search positions are what are referred to as off-page factors. Off-page factors make up almost 80% of search engines’ ranking algorithms, making accurate off-page analysis absolutely critical. These factors are mostly focused on links — the number of links you have, the anchor text used, and where these links are placed. The average web visitor can’t spot these off-page factors, and it’s difficult to identify them manually. Fortunately, at WebFX , we have a suite of services enabling off-page analysis and comparison. The server files affecting your SEO The server files affecting your SEO There are several files on your server — like .htaccess, robots.txt and sitemap.xml to name a few — that dictate how search engines access and index your content. Optimizing these files, so they are configured appropriately, can have a huge impact on your rankings (which is why we prioritize them as a part of our technical SEO audit services). .htaccess The .htaccess file is a distributed configuration file. This file allows you to specify and apply configuration directives on your site. This file enables you to call the shots on how users and search engines are directed to specific pages on your site, facilitate custom error pages and apply 301 redirects. robots.txt The robots.txt file placed in the root of a website prevents web spiders from accessing specific folders on your website. It is important to follow a specific format when optimizing this file. This file is typically used for folders that dilute the theme of your website or folders providing a dead end to robots, such as PDF files. Sitemap The creation, optimization and submission of a sitemap.xml file enables search engine spiders to better crawl your site. It also helps visitors to quickly scan your whole site for relevant information. This file provides a link and a short description of that link for each page of your site, prioritizing each page and providing a hierarchy of the most significant pages on your site to the least important pages on your site. Additional server configuration factors Additional server configurations such as accurate HTTP headers, accurate 404 error pages and page load times affect your search engine traffic as well. Audit Components: Your site earns the rankings the content deserves only when Googlebot can reach it cleanly. Legacy themes, bloated plugins, parameter sprawl from faceted navigation, redirect chains, and slow image delivery quietly burn crawl budget your priority pages need. Robots.txt, meta robots, canonicals, hreflang, and XML sitemaps point search engines toward the right page set. Core Web Vitals and mobile rendering are checked on the templates that matter most. The goal is a site that loads, crawls, and indexes cleanly enough for the rest of the SEO program to work. On-page SEO is where search intent, page structure, and buyer behavior meet. Titles and meta descriptions are reviewed for search intent, click value, and truncation risk. H1, H2, and H3 structure is checked for clarity, hierarchy, and keyword relevance.
